address: 7F, Bund 3, 3 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: Blue and white sofas work well with the wood and marble décor to exude a casual, yet elegant vibe, but it’s the breathtaking river views from the terrace that leave everyone in awe. Classic European choices abound on the menu, especially grilled meats and seafood. Try the house-made foie gras pâté, or pasta with black truffle. Pop also serves brunch every morning – so you can start your day with bacon and eggs with gorgeous vistas in the gentle morning sun....
